properties.title: Elrehan Azure Infrastructure Deployment Wizard (Resource Group Scope)

steps.name: basics
steps.label: Basics
steps.description: Configure the deployment target, subscription, resource group, primary region, and tags.

location.label: Resource Group Region
location.toolTip: Select the Azure region where the resource group's metadata will be stored.

elements.name: location
elements.label: Infrastructure Deployment Region
elements.toolTip: Select the Azure region where the infrastructure resources will be deployed. This can differ from the resource group region.

options.text: Cost Awareness: Network resources carry standard cloud charges. Virtual Machine deployment is optional and disabled by default (Pilot Safety Mode).

steps.name: networking
steps.label: Networking
steps.description: Create a new Virtual Network with dynamic subnets, or deploy into an existing Virtual Network across resource groups.

elements.name: vnetModeOptions
elements.label: Virtual Network Deployment Mode
elements.toolTip: Select whether to provision a new Virtual Network or reference an existing Virtual Network.

elements.name: vnetName
elements.label: Virtual Network Name
elements.toolTip: Name of the new Virtual Network (2-64 characters, alphanumeric and hyphens).

validations.message: VNet name must be between 2 and 64 characters.

elements.name: addressPrefix
elements.label: VNet Address Space (IPv4 CIDR)
elements.toolTip: The top-level IPv4 address prefix in CIDR notation (e.g. 10.0.0.0/16).

validations.message: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR prefix.

options.text: Subnet 1 (Mandatory Workload Subnet). Azure reserves 5 IP addresses per subnet. Sizing guide: /24 = 251 available IPs, /25 = 123, /26 = 59, /27 = 27, /28 = 11, /29 = 3 (smallest supported). Prefixes must be between /8 and /29.

elements.name: subnet1Name
elements.label: Subnet 1 Name
elements.toolTip: Name of the primary mandatory subnet (1-80 alphanumeric characters, hyphens, or underscores).

validations.message: Subnet name must be between 1 and 80 characters.

elements.name: subnet1Prefix
elements.label: Subnet 1 CIDR Prefix
elements.toolTip: IPv4 CIDR prefix for Subnet 1 within the VNet address space. Supported Azure prefix lengths are /8 through /29.

validations.message: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR prefix between /8 and /29 (/30, /31, and /32 are unsupported by Azure).

elements.name: enableSubnet2
elements.label: Configure Subnet 2 (Optional)
elements.toolTip: Enable to configure an independent secondary subnet in this Virtual Network.

options.text: Subnet 2 (Optional Secondary Subnet). Sizing: /24 = 251 available IPs, /25 = 123, /26 = 59, /27 = 27, /28 = 11, /29 = 3. Must not overlap with Subnet 1 or Subnet 3.

elements.name: subnet2Name
elements.label: Subnet 2 Name
elements.toolTip: Name of the secondary subnet.

validations.message: Subnet name must be between 1 and 80 characters.

elements.name: subnet2Prefix
elements.label: Subnet 2 CIDR Prefix
elements.toolTip: IPv4 CIDR prefix for Subnet 2. Must be non-overlapping with other subnets.

validations.message: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR prefix between /8 and /29 (/30, /31, and /32 are unsupported by Azure).

elements.name: enableSubnet3
elements.label: Configure Subnet 3 (Optional)
elements.toolTip: Enable to configure an independent tertiary subnet in this Virtual Network.

options.text: Subnet 3 (Optional Tertiary Subnet). Sizing: /24 = 251 available IPs, /25 = 123, /26 = 59, /27 = 27, /28 = 11, /29 = 3. Must not overlap with Subnet 1 or Subnet 2.

elements.name: subnet3Name
elements.label: Subnet 3 Name
elements.toolTip: Name of the tertiary subnet.

validations.message: Subnet name must be between 1 and 80 characters.

elements.name: subnet3Prefix
elements.label: Subnet 3 CIDR Prefix
elements.toolTip: IPv4 CIDR prefix for Subnet 3. Must be non-overlapping with other subnets.

validations.message: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR prefix between /8 and /29 (/30, /31, and /32 are unsupported by Azure).

- **Networking:** Multi-tier Virtual Network (or targeted existing VNet with cross-RG support).
